description: This file defines the URLConnector class which manages HTTP and HTTPS URL connections, including handling SSL configurations, timeouts, and trust levels. It provides static methods for opening connections with various security and trust options, as well as an internal thread class for establishing connections asynchronously.

classes.name: URLConnector
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing URL connections with customizable SSL configurations, timeouts, and trust policies.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection with a specified timeout, handling SSL configurations internally.

methods.name: openUntrustedConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection that allows untrusted SSL certificates.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL to which the connection is being made.

fields.name: clientCertAlias
fields.description: Alias for the client certificate used for SSL connections.

fields.name: timedOut
fields.description: Flag indicating if the connection attempt timed out.

fields.name: trustAnyCert
fields.description: Flag indicating if untrusted certificates should be trusted.
